description: Database of Flanged Reinforced Concrete Squat Walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jiaxing Ma, Nanyang Technological University Singapore (ntu.edu.sg). Flanged reinforced concrete (RC) squat walls are widely used in conventional buildings and nuclear facilities, due to their capabilities of meeting certain architecture demands and providing significant lateral strength and stiffness in both principle directions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-xhx1-hp60. Keywords: Database, Flanged Walls, Squat Walls, Reinforced Concrete. Published 2020-01-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
